hero.subtitle: Describe a motion graphic and an AI model writes it as code: kinetic typography, logo reveals, animated charts and more. It plays right here and exports to video in your browser.

examples: Kinetic typography intro for 'SUMMER SALE' with bouncing letters
Animated bar chart showing revenue growing from 2021 to 2025
Logo reveal with particles converging into a glowing ring
Countdown from 5 to 1 with bold flashing numbers
Lower third for 'Alex Rivera, Product Designer'

setup.title: Add a chat model key to use Vibe Motion
setup.body: Vibe Motion writes animations with a chat model. Add an OpenRouter, OpenAI or Google Gemini key in Settings → Providers. Your key stays in this browser.

composer.placeholder: Describe your motion graphic, e.g. kinetic typography intro for 'SUMMER SALE' with bouncing letters
composer.editPlaceholder: Describe a change, e.g. make it blue, slower, add a glow to the title

styleHints.minimal: Whitespace, one accent colour, precise motion
styleHints.bold: Heavy type, strong colour, punchy timing
styleHints.neon: Dark background, glowing lines and text

image.attach: Attach an image (logo or product shot) to use in the animation
image.tooLarge: Images up to 20 MB are supported.

loading.hint: The model is writing the code. This usually takes 20 to 60 seconds.

export.keepVisible: Recording in real time. Keep this tab visible until it finishes.

fix.title: The animation hit an error
fix.instruction: The animation throws this error in the browser: "{error}". Fix the bug so that window.__render(t) draws correctly for every t from 0 to the full duration.

errors.generationFailed: Vibe Motion could not write the animation
errors.exportEmpty: The recording came back empty. Keep the tab visible while exporting and try again.
errors.exportTimeout: The export took too long. Keep the tab visible while exporting and try again.
